purpose.domain_detail: Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) - Posting Defaults File Utilities for an Incomplete Records accounting system
purpose.summary: This program manages posting defaults for an accounting system. It provides a menu-driven interface to set up, amend, display, and print default account postings, as well as set up final accounts. It uses GnuCOBOL Report Writer for printing and screen sections for interactive display.

notable_features: GnuCOBOL Report Writer (RD, page heading, detail groups)
Screen Section with color attributes (foreground-color, background-color, reverse-video, blink)
Multiple COPY statements (envdiv.cob, wsnl.cob, wsfnctn.cob, wsdflt.cob, wsfinal.cob, screenio.cpy, wssystem.cob, print-spool-command-p.cob)
Long change history dating from 1983 to 2013
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full procedure division not visible. Program has a long history (1983-2013) and is part of a larger accounting suite. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial domain, likely due to GnuCOBOL free-format style preference.
